notes.title: ALPHA 2.0 IS HERE
notes.content:
ALPHA 2.0 IS HERE

Along with the new store page involving images, art, and screenshots!

We never really truly had an update log system before so I hope to catch up on previously made updates, including this current one.

Alpha 2.0:
   -added the pause menu with functioning quit button
   -added bedroom layout (the models in the bedroom are all just ment to be 
    place holders for more HD stuff
   - increased the height of the dark test area

Alpha 1.3: 
   -Added the Dyslexia

Alpha 1.2:
    -fixed a major bug making the game crash after the first time launching it
    -added dark test area
Alpha 1.0 
    -RELEASED THE GAME FOR PUBLIC BETA TESTING


------------------------------------------------------------------------------


                                                We also got a new store page verified!!!

This means that we will be able to announce any updates to the alpha build, and you guys will be able to comment and discuss bugs or features on post like this! Or even in the community hub!

So please, give us feedback and dont forget to enjoy watching the game grow!!!!!!!
